issue_request: FHIR-12361 asked to make Task.requester optional because requester may not always be available, and noted mailing-list suggestions that created and lastModified should not be mandatory. The final resolution was to make all three elements 0..1 and records that this had already been done.

additional_context: Task is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml, after the resource source refactor from spreadsheets to StructureDefinition XML, preserves the requested optional cardinalities. Community searches found no direct FHIR-12361 Zulip or Confluence references and no conflicting work-group decision.
